name: Kevin Vallejos
event: UFC Fight Night: Procházka vs. Stirling
summary: Argentine featherweight (18-1, 4-0 UFC, age 25) and one of the hardest punchers in the division. He has finished three of four UFC opponents, most recently knocking out Josh Emmett in round one in March. This is a big step up against a former champion and an elite grappler. He signed a new UFC contract in October.

how_they_fight.Striking: Heavy, compact power: 13 KO/TKO wins and about 1.4 knockdowns per 15 minutes. Against Emmett he stepped into the pocket with short hooks, uppercuts and elbows, slipped punches well, dropped him with a right and finished with knees at 3:33 of R1 (Cageside Press). Knocked out Giga Chikadze with a spinning backfist and elbows in R2 after Chikadze won much of R1 with kicks (Cageside).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Rarely looks for takedowns (about 1 per 15 minutes). Two submission wins on the regional scene. Uses the clinch against the fence to slow kickers (Chikadze).
how_they_fight.Defense: Good takedown defense so far (81%; Danny Silva went 1 for 9). He gets hit a fair amount (about 3.5 significant strikes absorbed a minute). Never stopped: his only loss is a three-round decision to Jean Silva on the Contender Series in 2023. He has not yet faced a high-level wrestler or back-taker in the UFC.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Early finisher. Of 15 stoppage wins, 9 came in R1, 5 in R2 and 1 in R3 (a 2023 regional submission). Three wins went the full 15 minutes, including a UFC decision over Danny Silva. He has never fought past round three; his one scheduled five-rounder (Emmett) ended in R1. Can lose R1 on volume and still finish in R2 (Chikadze).
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Confident and talkative: called for a 'pure striking' fight with Sterling and says a win earns him a shot at Volkanovski (Sherdog).

patterns: Pressure into the pocket with hooks, uppercuts and elbows
Finishes early: 14 of 15 stoppage wins in R1-R2
Good head movement on the way in
Comes back from losing R1 on volume
concerns: Untested against an elite wrestler and back-taker
Absorbs a fair amount of strikes
keys_to_beat: Take him down early and often; force him to defend the back
Use range and kicks; avoid the pocket
Drag him into deep water and see how he handles control time

news.text: Announced a new UFC contract and said he was stunned by the pay; said a win over Sterling gets him Volkanovski.
Predicted his fight with Sterling will be 'pure striking'; Sterling accepted.
Knocked out Josh Emmett at 3:33 of R1 at UFC Vegas 114.
